notes: Set runtime inputs and bind the instance before playing XpGain.
The animation owns progress; do not update it from the host.
XP counter and fill derive from the same progress value.
Reduce Motion uses a 150ms opacity fade into the final XP state.
The normal sequence fades out at 2200ms. The reduced-motion final state remains visible until the host unmounts it.
Mount with contain fit over the existing table and disable pointer interaction.
Level-up carry-over is not included; the fill clamps to the current cap.
The legacy fill and progressText properties are unused. Use currentXp, newXp and xpCap.
Game UI integration is not included in this asset handoff.
